'''Yboon Victoria García Ramos''' is a Peruvian [[mathematician]] with a Ph.D. from the [[:fr:Université_des_Antilles_et_de_la_Guyane|Université des Antilles et de la Guyane]] and the [[National University of Engineering]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yboon Victoria García Ramos |url=https://faculty.up.edu.pe/es/persons/yboon-victoria-garc%C3%ADa-ramos |access-date=2025-07-31 |website=FacultyUP — Universidad del Pacífico |language=es-PE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=IMCA -- Yboon Victoria Garcia Ramos |url=http://imca.edu.pe/es/alumno-graduado/yboon-victoria-garcia-ramos |access-date=2025-07-31 |website=imca.edu.pe |language=es}}</ref> Her research focus lies in applied mathematics, mathematical economics, and nonlinear analysis.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Día Internacional de las Matemáticas: Concytec celebra y rinde homenaje a cuatro especialistas peruanos |url=https://elperuano.pe/noticia/141280-dia-internacional-de-las-matematicas-concytec-celebra-y-rinde-homenaje-a-cuatro-especialistas-peruanos |access-date=2025-07-31 |website=elperuano.pe |date=14 March 2022 |language=es}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=2022-03-15 |title=Pi Day: meet four of the most outstanding Peruvian mathematicians |url=https://www.infobae.com/en/2022/03/15/pi-day-meet-four-of-the-most-outstanding-peruvian-mathematicians/ |access-date=2025-07-31 |website=infobae |language=es-ES}}</ref> She currently serves as a Full Professor and researcher at [[Universidad del Pacífico (Peru)|Universidad del Pacífico]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Yboon Garcia |url=https://www.up.edu.pe/Paginas/perfil-docente.aspx?idd=000123978 |access-date=2025-02-28 |website=Universidad del Pacífico |language=es-ES}}</ref> In 2019, she was awarded the “Sofia Kovalevskaya Prize: Outstanding Senior Peruvian Woman Researcher in Mathematics.”<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":4" />

== Education ==
Her interest in science led her to pursue a career in mathematics. She began her studies at the [[National University of Engineering]] where she continued until earning a Master's degree in Mathematics. She earned her Ph.D. at the [[:fr:Université_des_Antilles_et_de_la_Guyane|Université des Antilles et de la Guyane]] and the [[National University of Engineering]] in [[operator theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yboon Garcia Ramos - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=113089 |access-date=2025-03-15 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> She completed a postdoctoral fellowship at the Center for Mathematical Modeling at the [[University of Chile]].<ref name=":1" />

== Career ==
García has academic expertise in [[applied mathematics]], [[mathematical economics]], and [[nonlinear analysis]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=2024-03-14 |title=Día de las Matemáticas: conoce cuatro notables matemáticos peruanos |url=https://andina.pe/ingles/noticia-dia-las-matematicas-conoce-cuatro-notables-matematicos-peruanos-884700.aspx |access-date=2025-02-28 |publisher=[[Andina (news agency)|Andina]] |language=es}}</ref><ref name=":4" /> She has served as a thesis advisor for undergraduate students at UNI,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Directorio de Recursos Humanos afines a la CTI |url=https://dina.concytec.gob.pe/appDirectorioCTI/VerDatosInvestigador.do?id_investigador=3260 |access-date=2025-02-28 |website=dina.concytec.gob.pe |language=es}}</ref> and is currently a researcher at the Institute of Mathematics and Related Sciences (Instituto de Matemática y Ciencias Afines, IMCA).<ref name=":1" /> She is a member of both the Peruvian Mathematical Society and the [[Société mathématique de France]].<ref name=":1" /> In recognition of her contributions to science and technology, she has been accredited as a qualified researcher in RENACYT, the registry of Peruvian researchers .<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ficha RENACYT |url=https://servicio-renacyt.concytec.gob.pe/ficha-renacyt/ |access-date=2025-07-31 |website=Plataforma de servicio Renacyt |language=es}}</ref>

As coordinator of the Mathematics II course in the Department of Economics at [[Universidad del Pacífico (Peru)|Universidad del Pacífico]], she has continued to foster mathematical education and research.<ref name=":1" />

=== Research and publications ===
Her research has significantly contributed to the study of [[monotone operator]]s, quasiconvex [[Optimization problem|optimization]], and [[variational analysis]], with applications in [[Variational inequality|variational inequality problems]] and [[game theory]].<ref name=":0" />

In 2003, García co-authored an article with the co-founder of IMCA titled "Applications of the Ky Fan Conjecture."<ref name=":0" /> The paper presents [[Ky Fan's lemma]] as a tool for establishing existence results in various fields, including variational inequality problems, equilibrium problems, and game theory.

In 2014, she played a key role as the principal organizer of the Latin American Workshop on Optimization and Control. Previously, between 2011 and 2012, she served as the scientific lead of the Peruvian team in the Stic-Amsud OVIMINE project, further solidifying her impact in international research collaborations.<ref name=":1" />

In 2016, she published her first book, ''Cálculo Diferencial e Integral'' in collaboration with Oswaldo Velásquez.<ref name=":0" /> It covers [[Differential calculus|differential]] and [[integral]] calculus while also introducing fundamental mathematical concepts and their applications in economics and [[Business|business science]].

* {{Cite journal |last1=Flores-Bazán |first1=F. |last2=García |first2=Y. |last3=Hadjisavvas |first3=N. |date=2021-09-01 |title=Characterizing quasiconvexity of the pointwise infimum of a family of arbitrary translations of quasiconvex functions, with applications to sums and quasiconvex optimization |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10107-021-01647-w |journal=[[Mathematical Programming]] |language=en |volume=189 |issue=1 |pages=315–337 |doi=10.1007/s10107-021-01647-w |issn=1436-4646|url-access=subscription }}
* {{Cite journal |last1=Aussel |first1=D. |last2=García |first2=Y. |date=2014-01-01 |title=On extensions of kenderov's single-valuedness result for monotone maps and quasimonotone maps |url=https://faculty.up.edu.pe/es/publications/on-extensions-of-kenderovs-single-valuedness-result-for-monotone--2 |journal=SIAM Journal on Optimization |volume=24 |issue=2 |pages=702–713 |doi=10.1137/120880215 |issn=1052-6234|url-access=subscription }}
* {{Cite journal |last1=Aussel |first1=D. |last2=Garcia |first2=Y. |last3=Hadjisavvas |first3=N. |date=2010 |title=Single-Directional Property of Multivalued Maps and Variational Systems |url=https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/080735618 |journal=SIAM Journal on Optimization |volume=20 |issue=3 |pages=1274–1285 |doi=10.1137/080735618 |issn=1052-6234|url-access=subscription |hdl=10533/143038 |hdl-access=free }}
* {{Cite journal |last1=García |first1=Yboon |last2=Sosa |first2=Wilfredo |date=2003 |title=Aplicaciones de Lema de Ky Fan |url=https://dialnet.unirioja.es/servlet/articulo?codigo=9396212 |journal=TECNIA |volume=13 |issue=2 |pages=75–86 |issn=2309-0413}}

== Awards and honours ==
In 2019, Dr. Yboon García was awarded the “Sofia Kovalevskaya Prize: Outstanding Senior Peruvian Woman Researcher in Mathematics.”<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":4" /> This distinction aims to promote greater participation of women in mathematical sciences research. It is granted to female scientists with over 15 years of research experience who have demonstrated academic excellence.<ref name=":2" />
